parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for starting the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource.

Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates that the resource is a Bastionhost instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --next-token 6EwFJmScBXFFC3nf.9Rq7HzA7APx7GWLbkZbjHrR6Pq39w --resource-id 2 --tag Value=testapi Key=test --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 2 --Tag.1.Key test --NextToken '6EwFJmScBXFFC3nf.9Rq7HzA7APx7GWLbkZbjHrR6Pq39w' --ResourceGroupId 'example-string' --Tag.1.Value testapi --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
